title: The Lady and the Chest Press

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I take a short break in the trainers'
office one late afternoon,
Mejiro Ryan
bursts through the door looking like a
sweaty, nervous
wreck.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: This is bad... really, really bad! Not even the tastiest protein shake is gonna fix this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan nervously pulls out a
magazine to show me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the cover, drinking tea while striking
an elegant pose, is Mejiro
McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she does... But that's not the issue!
Look at this header on the
next page!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"The Magnificent Maidens of Mejiro, Part
One."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: M-magnificent... Maidens...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I just got a call from the magazine...
But I'm not like McQueen
at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
They're probably picturing some lovely
little lady who plays violin
while longingly
looking out the window! Like McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Urgh... Well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You and I have been talking about how I
need to try things I'm not
good at...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm still unsure how far my talents go, even
after all this time... But to
figure that out, I
must open myself up to new possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: And to do that, I need your help!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Okay, prepare yourself, Trainer! We're about to explore a world previously known to only McQueen and other elegant folks... The high-class mall.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Victoria, Mademoiselle, Prim & Preen... All
of these are super fancy
brands!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
N-no, I don't! Those names are just burned
into my mind after reading
that magazine
over and over again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Um... Do you mind if I take a look?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling the weight of the situation, Mejiro
Ryan approaches the shop.
After wavering
for a bit, she takes a step inside.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, a tulle skirt?! It's even got a ribbon
on the back! Ah, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
M-my thighs are a bit too jacked for this...
It'll look weird.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Frilly blouses like this suit McQueen
perfectly. If I tried to wear
them...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Gaaah, this is impossible!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This pattern continues for a while. Ryan
picks up each piece of
clothing with a
smile on her face, only to put it down
again with a
dejected look in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, she stops before a knit sweater
on display.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: A pink sweater... bejeweled with pearls...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I would never ever pick something like this normally...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But I gotta push myself! Yeah, just pretend
you're pumping out
another set of chest
presses... Excuse me, I'd like to try this on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We finish up our shopping and head home.
Despite our successful
trip, Mejiro Ryan
still seems antsy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I did it... I bought a pink sweater.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
O-of course! I mean, it's so elegant, so it
should work perfectly for the
magazine.
But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
For some reason... that just makes me more
nervous. My heart's
beating so hard, my
pecs are trembling!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Was that a cat? Where'd it come
from?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before us stands one of the many tall trees
lining the streets.
However, hanging from
this one is a kitten, its claws caught in the

branches.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the blink of an eye, the kitten's claws
finally give out, and it begins
to fall. It's at
least a thirty meter drop!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I've gotcha, little one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan rushes to the kitten, sweater
in hand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Come oooon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as the kitten is about to hit the
ground, Ryan manages to catch it
in her
sweater.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Phew... You're safe now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The kitten wiggles around in the sweater,
perhaps a little shaken, but
otherwise
unharmed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take the kitten in my arms, and my eyes
go wide...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The kitten's claws had clearly gotten
caught in the sweater. It's
completely
shredded...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's weird, but for some reason, I almost
feel relieved.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Going shopping at a fancy mall and
getting frilly clothes... It just
didn't feel
right to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I think I was trying too hard to be like
McQueen. I really stepped out
of my
comfort zone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But I realized something while I was
running towards that kitten.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I... am Mejiro Ryan, not Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I think frilly stuff is cute, but it's not ME, you know? What is me is dashing in to save a kitten! Nobody can beat me when it comes to taking action!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: And... I'm okay with that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I sure hope so! And you know... I think I'm
gonna do this photo shoot
in my gym
clothes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan beams with pride and
confidence. A few days later, I ask
about
the interview. She tells me it went off
without a hitch!
